systems.system: Centralized, statewide education management information system
systems.tiers: stated as not in existence as at 30 June 2023

note: Passages only. The summary states that, as at 30 June 2023, there is still no centralized statewide education management information system to give national data disaggregated by legal status, so refugee enrolment figures cover only schools where humanitarian actors work; it does not say what such a system would record or how schools keep learner records, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
